title: Write Any Email in 30 Seconds With AI (Free Method)
description:
Stop staring at a blank email. In this video you'll learn a simple 3-part prompt that makes AI write clear, professional emails for work, clients and job applications, plus the one check you should never skip. Subscribe for a new practical AI workflow every week.

This video was made with AI-assisted tools and narration.

scenes.narration: You spend hours every week writing emails. Here is how to do it in thirty seconds with AI.
scenes.headline: Emails in 30 seconds

scenes.narration: The problem is not the AI. It is the prompt. Most people type write an email, and get something generic.
scenes.headline: The real problem: your prompt

scenes.narration: Use a three part prompt instead. Part one, who you are writing to. Part two, what you need from them.
scenes.headline: Part 1: Who it's for

scenes.narration: Part three, the tone and length. For example, friendly but professional, under one hundred words.
scenes.headline: Part 2 & 3: Goal, tone, length

scenes.narration: Here is a full example. Write a short, polite email to a client asking for a payment that is a week late. Keep it friendly and firm.
scenes.headline: Example prompt

scenes.narration: In seconds you get a clean draft. Now add one more line: give me two other versions, one shorter and one warmer.
scenes.headline: Ask for 2 more versions

scenes.narration: Last step, and never skip it. Read it once, check names, dates and amounts, then send. AI drafts, you decide.
scenes.headline: Always check before sending

scenes.narration: Try this on your next email, and subscribe for a new practical AI workflow every week.
scenes.headline: Subscribe for weekly AI tips
